title: Conditional κ = 7.46709720962478·10⁻⁴: gen5b — exactly optimal local design and a debt-10 all-but-one module on #285's word, #287's stages re-derived, #233's complex supplier (+0.348% over #287)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.46709720962478·10⁻⁴: gen5b — an exactly optimal local design and a debt-10 all-but-one module on #285's word, with #287's stages re-derived and #233's complex supplier (+0.348% over #287)

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5b-banks/`, with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 373354860481239/(5·10¹⁷) = 7.46709720962478·10⁻⁴**, +0.348% over #287 and +0.525% over #285; bit coarse 7.47268·10⁻⁴, complex coarse 7.54736·10⁻⁴ (the bit side binds). This is a change of the bit word itself, before any entrance lever: it stands above #295's composed 7.45514·10⁻⁴ on its own, and the kernel, restoration and sink stages of #290/#295 can be re-derived on it.

## The word

#285's generator is run byte for byte with #285's compile-cost-annealed pair module and two new module data files:

* **Local design.** An exact model of the generator's per-cube arc rule (`discovery/local_model.py` reproduces the compiler's 29 additions / 13 arcs / debt 16 on all 220 cubes) and a CP-SAT search over all 15¹² recipe-tree choices (`discovery/cpsat_local.py`) prove **debt 16 optimal in this class** — #276/#285's design is optimal — and find an alternative optimum (28 additions, 12 arcs) that admits **1,726** compensated reuse pairs instead of 1,406.
* **All-but-one module.** The module's arc rule is combinatorial (verified frame-exactly on all 132 instances by `module_model.py`) and outputs can never be donors, so debt 10 is a floor; a symmetric CP-SAT model (`cpsat_abo_sym.py`) attains it with 35 additions and 25 arcs, against #285's annealed debt 11. #285 observed that a cyclic-interval debt-10 module costs the word 4.5%; this one lowers the word's descent cost 910,000.8 → 907,245.3 (−0.30%) with #285's local design and to 905,892.5 (−0.45%) with the alternative one.

| one invocation, m = 120 | gen5 (#285) | **gen5b** |
|---|---:|---:|
| virtual auxiliary roles | 17,292 | **17,160** |
| compensated reuse pairs | 1,406 | 1,726 |
| independent dirty registers R | 15,886 | **15,434** |
| independent entrances (ranks) | 2,554 | 2,234 (20 × 2,182, 21 × 34, 18 × 16, 17 × 2) |
| literal stock (60 replicas) | 1,247,070 | **1,236,750** |
| κ with #287's descent + target squares | 7.44120696397042·10⁻⁴ (#287) | **7.46709720962478·10⁻⁴** |

#287 ships frozen selections only; `discovery/descent_search.py` and `target_search.py` implement its stated rules (greedy concave descent of Σ r·ln(120/r) to frames on the operands' chains; squares with the literal F₂ response dependency, cut at the first target MOVE, close at the common next-need frame). On #285's word they reproduce #287's 904 gates and 220 squares exactly; on gen5b they find 904 and 220, committed as the package's selections. The complex supplier is #233's word (gcert/1 certificate of #256, Lean-checked in jacobalansussman/wht-power-saving-lean#2): with #193's supplier the bit side would sit only 0.025% below the cap.

## Checks

The new word passes both retained checkers (PR168-v4, 5 mutation controls rejected; PR200 word classes, formal identity, 4 adverse controls rejected), and `regenerate.py` reproduces the five pinned bit files byte for byte. `verify.py` runs all nine stages fresh — virtual, raw, bit (descent and targets), scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite — with nine omitted-stage negative controls. Every #287 literal the new word changes is recomputed and re-pinned (word sizes, entrance histogram, path census 17,194, parity counts, scalar events and hash, bank patterns: (3⁴⁰) 531 → 51 and (24⁵) 159,984 → 158,400 per stage, 4,630,200 assignments, 250 charts, selector calls 736,388,225,400, κ); no check is dropped.

## Verify

    python -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5b-banks/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5b-banks/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5b-verification       # about 4 minutes; not under -I
    python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5b-banks/gen5bit/producer/regenerate.py --work /tmp/gen5b-regeneration

## Scope and limits

* Conditional finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses (no Lean certificate for the bit side). #285 and #287 are open; their generator, pair module and stage code are reused unchanged.
* The pair module (debt 164 in #285) was not improved here (2.7·10⁶ annealing steps at debt 184 on gen4 found nothing; trivial bound 56). The alternative local design raises the weighted payload ADDs (753,472 vs 566,912), which only enters the finite bill; all its checks pass.
* Not composed here: the kernel (#290), restoration and sink (#295) stages; their re-derivation on gen5b is in progress.

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The generator and gen4/gen5 word design (including the pair module and the compile-cost method) are DreamingOfClouds' (#276, #285); the descent and target-square stages are rohanarun's (#287; target-prefix mechanism eumemic's #268); the five-stage package is eumemic's source527 lineage on hcg890's #234 layout and Jacob Sussman's construction; the complex word is ours (#233/#256) on ikeboy's #193 and icekylinx's #144. This package contributes the exact compile models and CP-SAT optimality results, the alternative local design, the debt-10 module, the gen5b word, the re-implemented searches and the re-pinned checks.
